label: Standard Rules
description: No special restrictions — build freely from the pool.

label: No Point Guards
description: Primary point guards are ineligible for this slot.

label: No Centers
description: Centers cannot be drafted for this slot.

label: Year Span +3
description: Pool expands to three seasons (year ±1) for extra options.

label: No All-Stars
description: All-Star selections are excluded from this pool.

label: Rookie Wave
description: Only first- and second-year players qualify.

label: Defense First
description: Only players with 80+ defense rating qualify.

label: Sharpshooters
description: Only players with 85+ shooting rating qualify.

label: Home Court Edge
description: +3% win chance boost during simulation for this lineup.

label: Injury Risk
description: Random player loses 10 health during simulation.
